definitions.explanation: The act of ending a quarrel or disagreement and restoring a friendly relationship.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}と{仲直|なかなお}りした。
examples.english: I made up with my friend.

examples.japanese: {喧嘩|けんか}の{後|あと}、すぐに{仲直|なかなお}りできた。
examples.english: After the fight, we were able to make up right away.

notes:
COMPOUND: {仲|なか} (relationship) + {直|なお}り (fixing, straightening)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {仲直|なかなお}りする (to make up, to reconcile)
- {仲直|なかなお}りできる (able to make up)
- 〜と{仲直|なかなお}りする (make up with ~)

RELATED TERMS:
- {喧嘩|けんか} (fight, quarrel)
- {仲|なか}が{良|い}い (to be on good terms)
- {仲|なか}が{悪|わる}い (to be on bad terms)
- {和解|わかい} (reconciliation - more formal)

Often used with the する verb to form {仲直|なかなお}りする.
